mode: read-only source audit; no build or GPU execution

decision.selected_protocol: One bounded 7-type x 3-behavior retained benchmark family. Every item is a retained leaf Cell and every mutation changes only leaf opacity. Run each type/behavior in a fresh process and compare a type only with its own baseline or candidate.
decision.status_of_initial_proposal: The earlier type-native payload mutation proposal is retained below as an explicitly unselected alternative. It must not be described as the implemented all-Blob method.

base.status: public open base with internal constructor/core hook; not a separately constructible benchmark leaf

public_leaves.distinct_work: content equality, shaping/layout, glyph atlas and text frame data
source identity, image layout, descriptor/resource reference and sampled draw
VectorPath identity/geometry, path atlas and vector draw
Container-like child reconciliation plus intrinsic focus/hit semantics and centered defaults
single-line buffer, text layout/paint and intrinsic input/focus semantics
stable controller/document, retained editor layout and visible text/caret/selection machinery

internal_indirect.disposition: Use as the retained mechanism for all seven leaves; it is not an eighth public leaf.
Keep in the existing VirtualTable workload; virtualization changes mounted cardinality and is not comparable to 1,000 visible leaves.
Exclude: internal leaf with no public construction or factory use found.
Treat as a Container/vector composition scenario, not a distinct Blob subclass; retain vector-quality coverage separately.

selected_uniform_opacity_method.status: selected and represented by the current AllBlobBenchmark source
retention_contract: The root Cell mounts 1,000 stable keyed leaf Cells once and must remain at RootBuildCount=1 for warmup and measurement.
Unchanged performs zero leaf mutations and zero leaf rebuilds, then ForceRender supplies the observational frame.
Sparse toggles opacity on one leaf Cell and rebuilds exactly that one leaf per sample; the rotating index follows the existing Sparse.cs sequence frame*17 modulo 1,000.
Full toggles opacity and rebuilds all 1,000 leaf Cells per sample; the root still never rebuilds.
Opacity alternates between 1.0 and 0.75, matching docs/perf/evidence/notes-triage-2026-09-04/Sparse.cs. Keys, geometry, type-native content and owned resource identities remain stable.

fixed_payload_by_type.Button: empty colored button with no callback or child text
fixed_payload_by_type.TextEntry: fixed Value x with no callbacks or input events
fixed_payload_by_type.TextEditor: one stable controller/document containing x per leaf, with no edits or input events

selected_uniform_opacity_method.purpose: Measures retained leaf invalidation, reconciliation, layout/paint propagation and rendering under one comparable authored mutation. It preserves the user Cells constraint and the established opacity workload.
limits: Uniform opacity does not cover Text content shaping changes, Image source replacement/upload, Shape path changes, TextEntry Value reconciliation, TextEditor document edits or commands, Button activation, or child-list topology changes.
Call it an all-public-leaf opacity benchmark, not comprehensive native payload or editing coverage.
Leaf types emit different primitive, text and resource work. Compare baseline/candidate within the same type and behavior; do not interpret cross-type absolute rankings as class overhead alone.
Opacity can change compositing and primitive output while payload identities remain stable. Report diagnostic primitive/text/draw/damage counts beside time.

unselected_type_native_payload_proposal.status: not selected; retain only as possible future targeted coverage
unselected_type_native_payload_proposal.difference_from_selected_method: This proposal changed each type's native payload. The selected benchmark changes only opacity and holds native payload stable.

lanes.proposed_native_change: toggle between two prewarmed shared ImageSources
toggle between two prewarmed equal-complexity VectorPaths
apply an equal-length document TextChange while retaining controller identity

unselected_type_native_payload_proposal.reason_not_to_merge_into_current_results: Those lanes exercise different subsystems and resource transitions by type, so they would remove the uniform operation needed for the selected 21-cell comparison matrix.

focus_audit.conclusion: The benchmark's TextEntry and TextEditor nodes remain unfocused by default under the controlled no-input harness. No TabIndex setting or new focused-node fixture hook is needed.
proof: AfterTreeUpdated assigns focus automatically only when findAutoFocus finds a focusable node with AutoFocus=true (Goo/Input/TextInput.gs:37-71).
Blob.AutoFocus defaults false because its state bit is unset unless explicitly initialized (Goo/Tree/Blob.gs:225-230); the benchmark does not set it.
TextEntry and TextEditor are intrinsically focusable (Goo/Tree/Reconciler.gs:410-432,526-528), but focusability alone does not call SetFocus.

Focus can otherwise arise through pointer dispatch, keyboard focus stepping, ElementHandle.Focus or an authored AutoFocus. The benchmark invokes none of these and only pumps an empty native event stream.
There is no TabIndex API in the current Goo source, and excluding nodes from tab order is unnecessary when no keyboard input is injected.
focus_audit.recommended_assertion: For the TextEditor lane, assert every retained TextEditorController.IsFocused is false after initial mount, after warmup and after measurement. This is a cheap direct check because controller focus is set only when its editor node is focused. For TextEntry, the controlled absence of AutoFocus and input is the source-level guarantee; adding 1,000 ElementHandles or a new fixture query would change the measured object graph without improving the contract.
focus_audit.window_focus: Window.IsFocused is native window activation and is distinct from element focus. Do not deliberately unfocus the OS window because that changes host scheduling and event behavior.
focus_audit.scope_limit: Controller.IsFocused validates TextEditor only. It must not be cited as direct runtime evidence for TextEntry; that lane relies on the controlled harness and focus-state proof above.

usable: The current AllBlobBenchmark source defines 1,000 retained leaf Cells for all seven public leaf types and zero/one/1,000 leaf rebuild behavior while keeping the root at one build.
The common performance helpers provide main-thread host-frame timing/allocation, process memory, Vulkan diagnostic counters, queue drain and percentile functions.
WindowReadbackFixture exposes diagnostic counters, AllTimestampSink, force render, target capture, target readback residency, primitive retention and window-level correctness helpers.
PrimitiveUploadBenchmark and the historical Sparse.cs provide comparable retained opacity workloads; TextEditingWorkload separately covers one 1 MiB interactive editor.
remaining_scope_limits: The all-Blob route does not measure the unselected type-native payload mutations.
A uniform opacity change does not normalize emitted primitive/text/resource counts across types.
ResidentResourceBytes is readback-pool memory only and must not be reported as total renderer or GPU residency.

gpu_timestamp_policy.capture: Use AllTimestampSink and align each stage snapshot to the diagnostic frame id.
gpu_timestamp_policy.primary_metric: gpu_main_* is the scoped Main interval; label it main-pass GPU time and not full GPU frame time.
gpu_timestamp_policy.do_not_sum: Never sum Upload, Main, Effects and Offscreen elapsed values. Main remains open while layer Effects and Offscreen scopes execute, so those stages overlap Main; nested offscreen scopes may also overlap. Each stage snapshot already aggregates its own scopes.
stage_reporting: For every stage report resolved sample count and elapsed percentiles, plus scope count and dropped-scope count when retained by the capture.
Require one Main sample per measured frame when timestamps are supported and require dropped-scope count zero.
Report Upload separately as timestamped text-atlas upload work; its scope is not every image/path/primitive upload.
Report Effects and Offscreen as attribution. Do not add either to Main and do not synthesize full-frame GPU latency from these scopes.

cpu: Time from immediately before leaf Advance through the forced accepted frame and queue drain, and report the scope precisely as host-frame wall time.
Record current-thread allocated bytes over the same interval, measured-loop wall time and process CPU time separately.
Require exactly one accepted submit and present per measured sample, monotonic frame ids and use of both frame slots.
memory: Capture managed live/retained, process working set/private memory and Vulkan allocator/device/cache/image/text residency before measurement, at bounded intervals and at the end.
Treat working set and private memory as process observations rather than exact Blob ownership.
Treat driver heap usage as device-global and valid only when budget/current flags say it is current.
Keep correctness readback outside the measured memory endpoint because it creates readback resources.

cleanup_audit.conclusion: Capture the actual VulkanWindowTarget before close and query that retained target after close. Window-based diagnostic access after close returns the default zero snapshot and cannot prove cleanup.
required_sequence: Before close, capture target = WindowReadbackTestFixture.CaptureTarget(opened) and take the final live diagnostic snapshot.
Request close and drain it through the normal render/close path.
After close, query TargetResidentResourceBytes(target) and the retained target's DiagnosticCountersSnapshotForTest, or an equivalent target wrapper.

Require readback residency zero, Vulkan object count zero and Vulkan allocated bytes/allocator bytes at their terminal expected values, then dispose benchmark-owned ImageSource and TextEditor controllers.
Run the existing common captured-error validator so validation, fatal and failed-result diagnostics are checked independently of numeric cleanup counters.
cleanup_audit.current_source_observation: tests/Goo.AsyncReadbackSmoke/AllBlobBenchmark.gs:553-567 captures the target before close and reads target residency and target diagnostic counters afterward. That is the correct evidence source; do not replace it with DiagnosticCounters(opened) after close.

verification_contract: Assert RootBuildCount remains exactly 1 through warmup and measurement.
Assert measured leaf rebuild and mutation counts are exactly 0 for unchanged, sample_count for sparse and 1,000*sample_count for full.
Assert stable item count, keys, topology, shared resource identity and TextEditor controller identity.
The current focus guarantee is source- and harness-based. An optional TextEditorController.IsFocused checkpoint loop would add direct editor evidence; do not claim it exists in the frozen source.
Use a separate short pixel preflight if visual opacity correctness is required; do not include readback allocation in timed or retained-memory results.
Record source/binary hashes, environment, GPU/driver, display mode, timestamp support, validation setting, warmup/sample counts, run order and exit status.

execution_matrix.repetitions: at least four balanced repetitions per cell for 84 total measured process runs

final_frozen_harness_review.source: tests/Goo.AsyncReadbackSmoke/AllBlobBenchmark.gs as inspected 2026-09-05 while the 21-case pilot was running
final_frozen_harness_review.disposition: No blocking defect found by read-only review. The count, timestamp, timed CPU/allocation, target-cleanup and owned-resource-finally paths match the selected uniform-opacity contract.
counts: All 1,000 child Cells mount during the sole root Build; the initial assertion requires RootBuildCount=1 and aggregate initial leaf BuildCount=1,000.

Advance returns without rebuilding for unchanged, rebuilds exactly one selected child for sparse, and rebuilds all 1,000 children for full. Warm and measured aggregate leaf BuildCount and MutationCount are checked against the exact 0/1/1,000 formulas.
The final pre-close assertion repeats RootBuildCount=1, preventing a hidden root rebuild in any mode.
Sparse uses (frame*17) modulo 1,000. Since 17 and 1,000 are coprime, it visits every leaf before repeating while still changing exactly one leaf per frame.
timestamp_frame_matching: The timestamp sink starts only after warmup and before the first measured frame. Each measured frame requires exactly one submit and one present, then stores VulkanWindowTarget.nextFrameId after ForceRender and DrainWindowQueue.

ForceRender may pass through rejected/nonaccepted attempts, so frame IDs are required to be strictly increasing rather than consecutive. The stored ID is the accepted frame latest at return and matches the frame value submitted with its timestamp context.
Eight post-measure forced frames allow two-slot asynchronous query results to publish. Resolve filters all captured snapshots by the measured expected frame IDs and rejects duplicate matches.

Capacity is sample_count+16 per stage, enough for the measured frames, eight resolve frames and the bounded pre-measure in-flight tail. The aggregate overflow and dropped-scope assertion covers every captured stage/frame.

When timestamps are supported, every measured frame must resolve exactly one Main snapshot. Upload, Effects and Offscreen may legitimately have fewer or zero matching snapshots because scopes are emitted only when that work exists.
Upload/Main/Effects/Offscreen values remain separate. Main may enclose Effects/Offscreen, so the four elapsed values must never be summed.
measurement_scope: cpu_* measures host-frame wall time from before leaf Advance through ForceRender and DrainWindowQueue. It is not enqueue-only CPU time.
managed allocation covers the same interval and stops before post-frame diagnostic and memory sampling.

The live/working-set/private start values are post-warm steady-state values. End values are captured after eight timestamp-resolution frames; they are post-drain steady-state values, not the exact last measured-frame boundary.

Managed retained start/end each invoke a full collection outside the timed sample interval. managed_retained_peak_B is only max(start,end), while managed_heap_peak_B and process/Vulkan peaks are sparsely sampled every 32 frames. Reports must preserve those labels and must not call them continuous peaks.
Vulkan allocator/device/cache/image/text values are Goo diagnostic allocation/residency counters. readback_pool_* is only the target readback pool, not general GPU residency or physical VRAM.
cleanup_and_disposal: The harness captures the non-null VulkanWindowTarget before close, then reads TargetResidentResourceBytes and TargetDiagnosticCounters from that retained target after close. It does not rely on the Window accessor that returns a default-zero snapshot after target removal.
Close requires readback pool bytes, allocator bytes, Vulkan device-memory bytes and Vulkan object count all zero.
AllBlobRoot derives from Cell and does not implement IDisposable, so Cell.DisposeMounted does not automatically dispose its benchmark-owned shared ImageSource or TextEditor controllers.

The explicit root.DisposeOwnedResources call is inside the innermost finally. The enclosing finally first removes the timestamp sink and closes any still-open window; the nested finally then disposes the ImageSource and every non-null controller even when measurement, validation or close throws.

Owned resources are disposed once on the normal path and every path that enters the main try. Root construction occurs before that try, so a constructor exception is the only theoretical partial-construction path outside this guard; the fixed in-memory constructor has no expected native/window failure point.

focus_advisory.finding: The frozen harness currently has no explicit TextEditorController.IsFocused assertion.
focus_advisory.assessment: The controlled benchmark still guarantees no element focus by construction: AutoFocus is false, no ElementHandle focus is requested and no pointer/key/text event is injected. Native Window focus alone does not focus an element.
focus_advisory.recommendation: If direct runtime evidence is desired before the final 63-run matrix, add an AllBlobRoot loop that requires every TextEditorController.IsFocused=false after mount, warmup and measurement. This needs no fixture and stays outside timed samples. Do not describe this assertion as executed unless it is actually added and rebuilt; TextEntry continues to rely on the controlled no-input source contract.
